name: Random Video
author: Alan
description: Bar button that opens a popup and plays a random video right inline. Configure one or more source URLs that already serve a different video on each request (a personal random-video endpoint, a redirect service, etc.) -- the plugin picks one at random, cache-busts the request, and plays it directly in the popup, with a reroll button for another pick and a one-click launch into mpv for its own window.

schema.label: Popup width (pixels, before theme spacing scale)
